{{Top|leg}}
'''Spawning beds''' were the method of reproduction used by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]]. Gree were created using a process of bio-engineering to fulfill certain roles within society, such as [[crafter]]s, [[researcher]]s, [[operator]]s, and [[Administrator (caste)|administrators]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the researcher and crafter castes were not produced any longer and many believed that the Gree had lost the proper processes to create them.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
